note: Datamaskinens og internettets maerkedage, som de staar i Q42's nerd calendar. Alle aarligt tilbagevendende.

days.why_da: 1939, i en garage i Palo Alto. Hvem af dem der skulle stå først i navnet blev afgjort ved møntkast.
days.why_en: 1939, in a garage in Palo Alto. Whose name came first was decided by a coin toss.

days.why_da: CES 1982. Den blev den bedst sælgende computermodel nogensinde — omkring 17 millioner stk.
days.why_en: CES 1982. It went on to become the best-selling single computer model ever — around 17 million units.

days.why_da: 2007. Steve Jobs sagde, han havde tre produkter med, og så viste han én ting.
days.why_en: 2007. Steve Jobs said he had three products to show, and then showed one thing.

days.why_da: 2001. Den begyndte som en sidevogn til et redaktionelt leksikon, der skulle have været det rigtige projekt.
days.why_en: 2001. It began as a side project to an edited encyclopedia that was supposed to be the real one.

days.why_da: Den første Mac kom i handlen 24. januar 1984, to dage efter Ridley Scotts 1984-reklame blev vist i Super Bowl. Nogle kalendere lægger dagen den 25.
days.why_en: The first Mac went on sale on 24 January 1984, two days after Ridley Scott's “1984” advert ran in the Super Bowl. Some calendars put the day on the 25th.

days.why_da: Europarådets konvention om databeskyttelse blev åbnet for underskrift 28. januar 1981.
days.why_en: The Council of Europe's data protection convention opened for signature on 28 January 1981.

days.why_da: Patentet på klodsen med de otte knopper blev indleveret 28. januar 1958 kl. 13.58. En klods fra den dag passer stadig på en, der er støbt i dag.
days.why_en: The patent for the eight-stud brick was filed on 28 January 1958 at 1:58 pm. A brick from that day still fits one moulded today.

days.en: The World Wide Web is born
days.why_da: Tim Berners-Lee afleverede sit forslag til CERN 12. marts 1989. Chefen skrev „vague but exciting“ i margenen.
days.why_en: Tim Berners-Lee handed his proposal to CERN on 12 March 1989. His boss wrote “vague but exciting” in the margin.

days.why_da: Dagen før 1. april, og det er med vilje: den, der ikke har taget backup, bliver narret dagen efter.
days.why_en: The day before 1 April, and deliberately so: anyone without a backup gets fooled the next morning.

days.why_da: 4/04. Dagen for alt det, der ikke er der.
days.why_en: 4/04. A day for everything that is not there.

days.why_da: Hjemmesider slår deres stilark fra en hel dag for at vise, at indholdet kan stå alene.
days.why_en: Websites switch off their stylesheets for a whole day to show that the content can stand on its own.

days.why_da: Samuel Morses fødselsdag, 1791. Han var portrætmaler indtil han var fyrre.
days.why_en: Samuel Morse's birthday, 1791. He was a portrait painter until he was forty.

days.why_da: CERN lagde kildekoden til WorldWideWeb i det offentlige domæne 30. april 1993. Uden den beslutning havde internettet set anderledes ud.
days.why_en: CERN placed the WorldWideWeb source code in the public domain on 30 April 1993. Without that decision the internet would look different.

days.why_da: Den Internationale Telegrafunion blev stiftet 17. maj 1865 — en af verdens ældste internationale organisationer.
days.why_en: The International Telegraph Union was founded on 17 May 1865 — one of the oldest international organisations in the world.

days.why_da: Verdensrekorden i længste kast med en papirflyver er over 77 meter.
days.why_en: The world record for the longest paper aeroplane throw is over 77 metres.

days.why_da: László Bíró fik patentet 10. juni 1943. Hans anden opfindelse var en automatgearkasse, som General Motors købte og lagde i skuffen.
days.why_en: László Bíró was granted the patent on 10 June 1943. His other invention was an automatic gearbox, which General Motors bought and shelved.

days.da: Tag din webmaster med til frokost
days.en: Take Your Webmaster to Lunch Day
days.why_da: En helligdag fra dengang en hjemmeside havde én ansvarlig, og man vidste hvem.
days.why_en: A holiday from the days when a website had one person in charge and everybody knew who.

days.why_da: Dagen for at rippe sin egen cd-samling, mens man endnu har et drev at gøre det med.
days.why_en: A day for ripping your own CD collection, while you still have a drive to do it with.

days.why_da: Datoen står på kalender-emojien 📅. Apple satte 17. juli ind, fordi iCal blev præsenteret den dag i 2002.
days.why_en: The date is printed on the calendar emoji 📅. Apple put 17 July there because iCal was announced that day in 2002.

days.why_da: info.cern.ch gik i luften 6. august 1991. Den forklarede, hvad World Wide Web var, og hvordan man selv kunne lave en side.
days.why_en: info.cern.ch went live on 6 August 1991. It explained what the World Wide Web was and how to make a page of your own.

days.why_da: IBM Model 5150 kom 12. august 1981. IBM lod BIOS'en være åben nok til at andre kunne bygge kopier — og dermed opstod hele pc-industrien ved et uheld.
days.why_en: The IBM Model 5150 arrived on 12 August 1981. IBM left the BIOS open enough for others to build clones — and the whole PC industry happened by accident.

days.why_da: 16. august 1995, som en del af Windows 95 Plus!. Den levede i 27 år.
days.why_en: 16 August 1995, as part of the Windows 95 Plus! pack. It lasted 27 years.

days.why_da: Den franske stat købte daguerreotypiet 19. august 1839 og forærede det til verden som en fri opfindelse.
days.why_en: The French state bought the daguerreotype on 19 August 1839 and gave it to the world as a free invention.

days.why_da: Google Inc. blev registreret 7. september 1998. Firmaet selv fejrer sin fødselsdag den 27. — de har flyttet den flere gange.
days.why_en: Google Inc. was incorporated on 7 September 1998. The company itself celebrates on the 27th — it has moved the date more than once.

days.why_da: Den 256. dag i året, fordi 256 er 2⁸ — antallet af værdier i én byte. I skudår falder den 12. september.
days.why_en: The 256th day of the year, because 256 is 2⁸ — the number of values in one byte. In leap years it falls on 12 September.

days.why_da: En dag for den, der kommer og retter det, man selv har ødelagt.
days.why_en: A day for the person who comes and fixes what you broke yourself.

days.why_da: Den eneste helligdag, hvor det er pointen, at alle gør det på samme måde.
days.why_en: The only holiday whose entire point is that everybody does it the same way.

days.why_da: Californien udnævnte 16. oktober 2011 til Steve Jobs Day, elleve dage efter hans død.
days.why_en: California named 16 October 2011 Steve Jobs Day, eleven days after his death.

days.why_da: EN DAG, HVOR DET ER TILLADT. Opfundet i 2000 som en kommentar til folk, der råber på nettet.
days.why_en: ONE DAY WHERE IT IS ALLOWED. Invented in 2000 as a comment on people who shout online.

days.why_da: Den første besked på ARPANET blev sendt 29. oktober 1969. Den skulle have været „LOGIN“, men systemet brød ned efter „LO“.
days.why_en: The first message on ARPANET was sent on 29 October 1969. It was meant to be “LOGIN”, but the system crashed after “LO”.

days.why_da: 29. november 1972. Den første automat gik i stå, fordi møntboksen var stoppet helt op med kvarter.
days.why_en: 29 November 1972. The first machine broke down because the coin box was jammed solid with quarters.

days.why_da: Indført i 1988, samme år som Morris-ormen lammede en tiendedel af internettet.
days.why_en: Started in 1988, the same year the Morris worm took out a tenth of the internet.

days.why_da: Den anden tirsdag i oktober, for kvinder i naturvidenskab og teknik. Lovelace skrev verdens første program i 1843 til en maskine, der aldrig blev bygget.
days.why_en: The second Tuesday in October, for women in science and engineering. Lovelace wrote the world's first program in 1843, for a machine that was never built.
